verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports collection runners, unlimited collection runs, CLI (inso) for CI/Git workflows, and chaining/pre-request scripts for assertions, which together enable automated test suites with pass/fail reporting. However, explicit documentation of a structured pass/fail report format or test assertion syntax is thin, and no independent hands-on confirmation of report output exists. Missing for 10: detailed docs on assertion/test scripting syntax, explicit pass/fail report UI/output evidence, independent verification of CLI test reporting.
